notes: Named sound effects, converted from Media/sound/sys.bin (entry numbers of the original bank).

The menu plays entry 3 when the cursor moves (0xdf410), 4 when SCREEN ADJUST moves the picture sideways, 5 on confirm, 8 on cancel and for an unavailable item, and the title 14 on START. A message box plays 12 as it opens (0xbec0f).
